title: Generative Compliance: Absurdities I Was Not Expecting.
subtitle: Mount Sinai Health system needs to up its compliance game
text:
Generative Compliance: Absurdities I Was Not Expecting.
Mount Sinai Health system needs to up its compliance game
OWEN SCOTT MUIR, M.D.
MAR 16, 2023
∙ PAID
3

Oh my. I didn’t think I didn’t think I’d have more to say. I went to the MSSM website to look up and email the Compliance Officer—they have one. What they don't have is any email address for him. The links just let you send his profile to others, not email him…

First off, the search doesn’t work:

And the compliance page doesn't list the CCO either…

Ok, my bad. He’s SVP Compliance:

And Chief Risk Officer. But none of those Links work. The just let you email him to someone else, like I am doing now.

But, when you leave the website, it give you the option of a survey. Let’s see how that goes:

O

One star. Next question.

Next question…

Not at all. Am I done yet?

Really?

Finally I can tell them why I came.

Sure, I will participate in research.

No, thank you.

But for serious, it’s a health system with an ADA non compliance problem and a compliance officer you can’t find an email for.

This is not at all Ok.

—Owen Muir, M.D.
